eventfd.prototype: int eventfd(unsigned int initval, int flags);
eventfd.description: eventfd() creates an "eventfd object" that can be used as an event  wait/notify mechanism by user-space applications, and by the  kernel to notify user-space applications of events. The object  contains an unsigned 64-bit integer (uint64_t) counter that is  maintained by the kernel. This counter is initialized with the  value specified in the argument initval.
